subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked with a merge base, docgate shall fail any diff to the configured system-map documents (defaults `docs/domain-model.md` and `docs/system-design.md`) that removes or renumbers an `INV-<n>` invariant-registry row or a `D<n>` open-decision row present at the merge base; a map file absent from the tree is skipped without defect.
rationale: registry IDs are permanent citation anchors inside deliberately mutable documents — the one quasi-authoritative class with zero protection (#54 C3)
fit_criterion: fixtures: removing INV-33 red; renumbering an INV row red; appending a fresh INV row green; editing non-registry prose green; absent `system-design.md` produces no defect; the real corpus green
